semiconductor_relevance: High — Nippon Sanso Euro-Holding S.L.U. provides industrial and specialty gases essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Nippon Sanso Euro-Holding S.L.U. specializes in gas technology, offering a range of gases and mixtures that are critical for various semiconductor applications. With a strong commitment to innovation and sustainability, they serve a diverse customer base across Europe and beyond.

regional_presence.Europe: The company operates in 14 countries across Europe, serving over 150,000 customers.
